work_items: {Add Protected Application-Validation Plane to Wave 3 Implementation}
validations: {Implement Protected Application-Validation Plane with bounded browser, accessibility, network, screenshot-regression and multimodal evidence}

AC-01: validate protected requirement — Validation resolves exact Project/run/approved Work-Spec/source-lineage/Preview identity from persisted delivery evidence. Caller/model supplied URL, wrong Project/run/spec/digest/lineage, stale/conflicting delivery record or non-ready/missing Preview fails closed before browser execution.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — Versioned workflows expose only bounded typed relative navigation, semantic interaction/assertion, registered viewports and screenshot checkpoints. Arbitrary JavaScript/eval, shell, generic HTTP, arbitrary hosts/headers/cookies/credentials and unbounded selectors/actions are impossible through the workflow contract.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — Production browser execution retains deny-all network posture except the exact persisted Preview hostname. Unexpected external requests are blocked/recorded. Wildcard internet, model-selected domain and redirect escape cases fail closed without weakening BUILD/TEST/VERIFY network policy.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — Required semantic assertions, accessibility policy, page/console errors, failed required requests and unexpected external-network behavior produce bounded deterministic evidence and protected pass/fail. A multimodal PASS cannot convert a deterministic FAIL into success.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — Registered viewports detect protected overflow/clipping, hidden required UI and blocking overlays/obstructions with bounded geometry evidence. Deliberate layout/overlay regressions in the reference harness fail before visual-model judgment.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — Screenshots are bound to Project/run/Work-Spec/source-lineage/Preview/workflow/viewport identity and represented in ordinary evidence by artifact ref/digest/dimensions. Cookies, storage values, auth headers, secret query data, raw unbounded DOM/log/network payloads and unrelated Project data are never persisted in browser evidence.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Deterministic comparison rejects cross-Project/workflow/viewport or stale baseline provenance, records bounded difference metrics/digests, and fails candidates exceeding protected thresholds. Baselines are never automatically updated to make a candidate pass.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Multimodal review consumes approved screenshot artifacts and bounded context only after deterministic evidence, returns typed findings/confidence without hidden reasoning, and cannot alter deterministic outcomes, acceptance criteria, baseline thresholds or authority.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Permanent reusable scenarios prove wrong/stale provenance, semantic failure, accessibility failure, console/page failure, required-network failure, external request, clipping/overflow, blocking overlay, screenshot regression and deterministic-vs-multimodal disagreement are rejected as specified.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — One normalized protected browser-validation result can be consumed by #97 after process recreation and remains bound to the persisted delivery/lineage facts. Evaluation/diagnosis does not recreate GitHub commits, PRs or Vercel Preview deployments.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — Browser validation adds no source mutation, provider mutation, generic network, production promotion or evaluator-threshold authority. Existing source lineage, provider replay, #46 scoring/critical-failure and operator REVIEW/production boundaries remain intact.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — P2-V0.16.2 has authentic committed DSPy critic/compiler evidence. The exact worker head passes Workstream Spec Validation, P2 CI and Bounded Autonomy plus browser/reference-harness validation before integration, and final Wave 3 integration reruns protected cumulative gates.
risks: {No material risks identified, deterministic failures remain authoritative}

critique: The implementation of a protected application-validation plane in the approved software specification poses a material risk. The proposed implementation lacks a robust mechanism to ensure the integrity and authenticity of the validation process, which could lead to compromised browser validation results.
